retrievalProfile.description: A soft-focus studio portrait featuring a central subject against a hazy, multi-tonal pink and purple gradient backdrop with wide-tracked stylized headers.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot studio portrait of a woman with long dark hair, wearing a fringed cream vest and denim, set against a diffused, smoky pink and lavender background. The lighting is soft and directional, creating a gentle glow on the skin, while the overall image has a fine film grain and low-contrast shadow detail characteristic of 1970s analog photography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered with a slight tilt for dynamic balance
Soft-edged silhouette blending into a hazy atmospheric background
High-contrast texture of fringe and denim against smooth skin and blurred backdrop
Typography positioned at the extreme top edge to frame the subject
coreInvariants: Wide letter spacing in the header

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot; subject occupies approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes, highlighted by soft key lighting.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the wide-spaced title at the top, down the line of the subject's hair, to the textured fringe of the vest.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample hazy space surrounding the subject, particularly in the upper corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted pink and lavender (background and atmosphere)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep indigo and black (hair and denim)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Mid-range saturation with a lifted black point, creating a 'dusty' or 'faded' vintage look.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric Sans with Art Deco influences
letterConstructionRules: Open counters and stylized, curved terminals on characters like 'C' and 'S'
characterSpecificRedesigns: C and S feature elongated, hook-like terminals
H and E have high-waisted crossbars
R has a detached or stylized leg
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative face used sparingly to maintain focus on the portrait.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the stylized, arts-and-crafts geometric feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with long dark hair in 1970s bohemian attire, using a soft-focus lens and a hazy pink and lavender gradient backdrop with visible film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of uppercase text at the very top edge using a thin, stylized geometric font with extremely wide letter spacing in white.

verificationChecks: Is the background a soft, smoky pink/purple gradient?
Is the typography tracked out significantly?
Does the image have a soft-focus, analog film quality?
Is the subject's styling consistent with 1970s folk-rock aesthetics?

adjustableVariables: Specific hue of the pink/purple gradient
postGenerationChecks: Check for soft-focus consistency across the subject
Verify the typography is centered and widely spaced
Ensure the color palette remains in the muted pink/lavender range
Confirm the grain texture looks organic rather than digital noise
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject Description] + [70s Studio Lighting] + [Hazy Pink/Purple Gradient Backdrop] + [Wide-Spaced Stylized Header].
